flawed_step: Line 0029 incorrectly claims that executing A[A[0]-1] := A[0] from A[0]=2 and A[1]=3 yields A[0]=1 and A[1]=1.
counterexample: Take the concrete array A=[2,3]. The index A[0]-1 evaluates to 1, and the right-hand side A[0] evaluates to 2. Thus the assignment sets A[1]:=2, producing A=[2,2], not A=[1,1].
assessment_summary: The proof contains a false concrete claim in its array-update example, refuted by directly executing the stated assignment.
